تكتمني (form VIII)
# تَكْتَمِنِي (taktaminī) /tak.ta.mi.niː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِكْتَمَنَ (iktamana)
# تُكْتَمَنِي (tuktamanī) /tuk.ta.ma.niː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِكْتَمَنَ (iktamana)
